summary.result: Overall results demonstrated that the probable precipitation amounts using the non-stationary frequency analysis were overestimated.
summary.background: In this study, we estimated probable precipitation amounts at the target year (2020, 2030, 2040) of 55 weather stations in Korea using the 24 hour annual maximum precipitation data from 1973 through 2009 which should be useful for management of agricultural reservoirs.
summary.method: Gumbel distribution was chosen and probability weighted moment method was used to estimate model parameters.
